Title: Public Preview Azure Service Bus Enhancements

Body.Content:
Azure Service Bus is a fully managed enterprise message broker that ensures secure and efficient delivery of data messages between different parts of your system, even when they're disconnected or processing tasks at different speeds. We're thrilled to announce a new feature to streamline message management and improve operational efficiency: batch delete. Currently in preview, this feature enables customers to delete messages on the service side from an entity or the dead letter queue in batches of up to 4,000 messages.

Click here to learn more about batch delete.
